data.name: Karlie
data.gender_notes: Karlie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A derivation of Karl, which is from the Old Norse name Kálfr meaning 'hard ruler'. This name is a popular choice for girls in the English-speaking world and is often associated with strength and courage. The name Karlie carries the meaning “Man's strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Karlie usually hope their child will grow to embody man's strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes inner strength, courage, and resilience in the face of challenges. It reminds us of the power of the human spirit and the importance of staying true to our values and beliefs.
data.etymology: Karlie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Man's strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Karlie total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
